text_block_list.text: The new year has begun.

"Uooooh! Go, go, right there!" "Don't 
lose, give it your all!"

This year, I came to watch an amateur race 
together with Victoire Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Well, you see—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It appears... an old friend from my junior 
club days will be running in a race...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's not as though I received an 
invitation. I'm just quietly watching from 
the stands, but—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Would you mind joining me, if it's 
alright with you?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I might burst into tears if 
I'm all alone.

—Midway through the race, an old friend 
sits mid-pack, waiting like a tiger eyeing 
its prey ahead.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"She was the fastest one in our junior 
club. Even I could only beat her a handful 
of times."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, she ended up quitting too because 
of the fire....”

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, past the final turn and into the home 
stretch! Who will make their move—?!

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend
text_block_list.text: From here on out!!

Perhaps due to her hiatus, her form was 
unsteady. Her moves were visibly 
unpolished, and though she took the lead, 
one by one she was passed right before the 
finish line. However—

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend
text_block_list.text: ...! Daaaaaaah――!!!

Her profile as she sprinted through with 
all her might was so dazzling it was 
burned into my mind.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah...! Ah, damn it! Not good 
enough, huh!

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... Yeah, but—ahaha! It really is so 
much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I kept running.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend
text_block_list.text: Pisa!?

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wha, what, how did you kno— Wait. 
You... you came—

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aaah! Ugh, uuuuugh~!

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Old Friend
text_block_list.text: Pisa, thankg you... zo muchhh~~!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, —Fufu, fufufu!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"No, it is I— I should be the one thanking 
you...!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Even though you came along with me, it 
was no good, was it? I ended up crying."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm glad I got to watch it. Truly. 
Thank you so very much.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...She took a step forward, too. In that 
case, I can't afford to slack off either."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I must give it my all for another whole 
year.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do our best together.
Yeah, let's do our best together.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, looking forward to working with you. 
...Come to think of it, do you have any 
errands in town today?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Think of it as a return favor for 
accompanying me... Besides, it's New 
Year's, after all.

Prompted to do so, I turn it over in my 
mind. What comes to mind is—
choice_data_list:
Won't you come see the shopping street's 
New Year's festival with me?

Wanna go check out the New Year's festival 
at the shopping street?

How about trying some traditional New 
Year's games?

Head to the New Year's sale at the 
shopping mall

Prompted to do so, I turn it over in my 
mind. What comes to mind is—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, sounds wonderful♪ Shall we head over 
right away?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's quite lively, isn't it? Is that... 
mochi pounding, perhaps?

Where she was pointing, they seemed to be 
holding a mochi-pounding event as part of 
the festivities.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If we line up in that queue, we get to 
swing the wooden mallet and pound mochi, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
—7, 8, 9, 10! Looking good, it's getting 
nice and shiny! All right, next person!

text_block_list.name: Boy Participating in Mochi Pounding
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
When everyone's strength comes together, a 
single mochi is completed, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, why don't you give it a 
try?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
—7, 8, 9, 10! All right, next person! Grip 
it tight and—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Hup...! Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
—7, 8, 9, 10! As expected, you've got 
great aptitude! Right, next person!
And—

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: It's, done~!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to everyone, the completely dry 
glutinous rice has turned springy and 
glossy! Truly, working with one heart and 
united strength!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"So let's give it our all again this 
year~! I'm making mochi, so take home as 
many as you want!"
(Clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Mochi Pounding Participant A
text_block_list.text:
"I'm tired, but that was fun~ I should get 
something for my family... wait, oh no, my 
hands are full. What should I put it in?"

text_block_list.name: Mochi Pounding Participant B
text_block_list.text:
Um, would you like to use this container 
if you want?

text_block_list.name: Mochi Pounding Participant A
text_block_list.text: Huh?! A-Are you sure about this...?!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "...Fufu, shall we dig in too?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A wonderful circle made by mochi... isn't 
it? ♪

With the turbulent winter behind us— New 
Year's Day felt somehow peaceful once 
again this year.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A game suitable for New Year's? In that 
case... how about flying kites?

And so, we bought a kite at a nearby shop 
and decided to fly it on the riverbed 
afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Wah, everyone's flying their kites so 
well. That one over there is super high 
up...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That's true. Especially on a New Year's 
Day with great weather, it makes me really 
want to fly one.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A long time ago... I flew a kite with my 
parents. It was a big, white kite shaped 
like a bird.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Father
text_block_list.text:
Pisa, feel the wind as you run! Faster, 
even faster!

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text: A-Alright! Hyah...!

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Wah!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A white kite flew high in the blue sky, 
its back bathed in the bright sunlight.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"That powerful figure... I wonder why. It 
feels like she's watching over all of us."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Even as a child, it gave me the energy to 
think, 'I'll do my best for another year.'

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes. ...Come now, why don't you give 
it a try too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The weather today is simply splendid, 
after all. I'm certain she will soar high, 
so very high.

With the turbulent winter behind us—this 
year's New Year's Day turned out to be an 
uplifting, energizing day.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? ...To be honest, I really 
wanted to go today.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
There's a shop where someone I want to see 
works.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Pisa! And Trainer, too. Happy New 
Year. Did you really come all this way to 
see me?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Happy New Year. I couldn't help but 
feel a little curious after all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
This shop belongs to a friend of my 
mother's. I'm helping out this year as a 
special favor.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Mother
text_block_list.text:
The lucky bags are wildly popular. It's 
calmed down a lot now, but it was crazy 
this morning.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, that's right. There was a piece of 
jewelry I thought would look wonderful on 
you, so I had it put on hold. I'll go 
fetch it for you."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: A turquoise bracelet?

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Wishing that this year, too, will be 
filled with "hope."

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Dad and I have been watching your 
successes. You really... haven't changed 
at all.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Mother
text_block_list.text:
So translucent, yet so resilient... You 
are our pride.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Mom... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm rooting for you. Do your best! 
You too, Trainer.

With the turbulent winter behind us— New 
Year's Day felt somehow peaceful once 
again this year.

To connect the circle further and foster 
new hope. I want to sprint alongside her 
through another year.
